name: Eldegoss
description: Eldegoss, the Cotton Bloom Pokémon, and the evolved form of Gossifleur. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
